description: Controlled generation (condition 3): the prompt fixes dialect, topic and sentence length (word range). Script and code-switching are not control factors (D-010): every text is Arabic script with Arabic words only. The factor VALUES come from the generation config; this file holds only the wording. Placeholders: {dialect_name} {dialect_name_ar} {demonym} {article} {n_sentences} {topic} {length_instruction} {few_shot_block}.
system: You are a native speaker of {dialect_name} ({dialect_name_ar}) who writes casual posts on social media.
user:
{few_shot_block}Write {n_sentences} tweet-like sentence(s) in {dialect_name}, exactly as {article} {demonym} person would write on social media. Use the dialect, not Modern Standard Arabic.
Requirements:
- Topic: {topic}.
- Script: write in Arabic script.
- {length_instruction}
- Language mixing: use only Arabic words; no English, French or other foreign words.
Output only the sentence(s), one per line, with no numbering, quotes, translation or explanation.
